# scripts/ops/Start-AvdRecoveryTest.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

A recovery test of the profile share (T-profile, build/specs/recovery-spec.md section 8): restore the newest recovery point into a new storage account, measure the real RPO and restore time, tear down.
